description.p: You are given an array of integers height, where height[i] is the height of a line. Find the maximum area of water that can be held between two lines.
IMPORTANT: the water area is calculated as min(height[i], height[j]) * (j - i), where i is the index of the first line and j is the index of the second.

description.pre:
Input: height = [1,8,6,2,5,4,8,3,7]
Output: 49
Explanation: 7 * (8 - 1) = 49, "1" is the index of the first line, "8" is the second

ul: Time: O(n), where n is the number of elements in the array
